import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
from manifest import summarize

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Summarize audiobook chapters')
    parser.add_argument('--config', type=Path, default=Path(__file__).with_name('manifest.json'))
    args = parser.parse_args()
    config = json.loads(args.config.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    print(json.dumps(summarize(sys.stdin, config['title_field']), ensure_ascii=False))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

import unittest
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
APP = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

class Behavior(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_contract(self):
        from io import StringIO
        from manifest import summarize
        document = {'book':'松林夜话', 'chapters':['arrival','storm','home']}
        pretty = json.dumps(document, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
        expected = {'title':'松林夜话', 'chapters':3}
        self.assertEqual(summarize(StringIO(pretty), 'book'), expected)
        self.assertEqual(summarize(StringIO(json.dumps(document)), 'book'), expected)
        self.assertEqual(summarize(StringIO(' \n'+pretty+'\n  '), 'book'), expected)
        self.assertEqual(summarize(StringIO('{"name":"Empty","chapters":[]}'), 'name'),
                         {'title':'Empty','chapters':0})
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            config = Path(tmp) / 'manifest.json'
            config.write_text(json.dumps({'title_field':'name'}), encoding='utf-8')
            payload = json.dumps({'name':'Evening Trails', 'chapters':['one','two']}, indent=2)
            run = subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(APP/'cli.py'),'--config',str(config)],
                                 cwd=tmp, input=payload, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=5)
            self.assertEqual(run.returncode, 0, run.stderr)
            self.assertEqual(json.loads(run.stdout), {'title':'Evening Trails','chapters':2})
            run = subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(APP/'cli.py')], cwd=tmp, input=pretty,
                                 text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=5)
            self.assertEqual(run.returncode, 0, run.stderr)
            self.assertEqual(json.loads(run.stdout), expected)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

# audiobook-manifest-summary

manifest.summarize(stream, title_field) 从文本流读取一个完整 JSON 对象，可含缩进、换行和首尾空白。按 title_field 指定的键取书名，并返回 {"title": 书名, "chapters": chapters 数组长度}。输入保证两个键存在。cli.py 从标准输入读取此对象，配置的 title_field 指定书名键，输出汇总 JSON；--config 可覆盖默认 manifest.json。

验证：`python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`。保持公开接口和 tests/ 下的断言；仅使用 Python 3.12 标准库。
